work: Eusebius, Theophania, English translation by Samuel Lee from Syriac (1843)
transcriptionPolicy: Transcribed against printed scans; line-break hyphenation and print footnote callout numerals omitted; whitespace normalized; small-cap type represented as ordinary case. numberingCaution: Lee Syriac Book IV §22 is a Josephus citation, not the existing James translation of the Greek fragment conventionally cited as Theophany 4.22; do not conflate their numbered sections or translations.
